fields.statement: Verified at 4c99a781 (attempt 2). Read the diff: runRunStart refuses --autonomous on a plan run with --milestone, with --request naming a milestone-kind request (new: requestRun now returns the request and its Kind is checked before any draft opens, --milestone or not), or on a record change set (planIsMilestone); runRunResume refuses a plan run journaled autonomous on a record change set; all use milestoneNeedsOwner, a usage error saying milestone planning needs the owner. Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(run-start-milestone-autonomous|plan-workflow-autonomous|plan-workflow-autonomous-left|plan-requests|describe-golden) -v: all PASS. run-start-milestone-autonomous checks exit 2 with the rule for --new --milestone, a record change set, and a milestone request without --milestone (dry run and real), no new draft and no journal; the record start without --autonomous succeeds, an autonomous --new intention succeeds with autonomous true, and run resume of the record run edited to autonomous exits 2 with the rule. plan-workflow-autonomous and -left now start on an intention (--new, no --milestone), the fake claude asserts RHIZA_AUTONOMOUS=1, and the gate accepts with rule autonomous. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... ok.
